Animals: Body Plans · 1/10

Animal or not?是不是动物？

Animals are multicellular heterotrophs with no cell walls. They ingest food and most can move at some stage of life.动物是多细胞异养生物，没有细胞壁，摄取食物，大多数在生命的某个阶段能运动。

Animals: Body Plans · 2/10

Vertebrate or invertebrate?脊椎动物还是无脊椎动物？

Only animals with a backbone are vertebrates. They are about 5 percent of species. Insects, worms, snails and jellyfish are invertebrates.只有有脊柱的动物才是脊椎动物，约占物种的 5%；昆虫、蠕虫、蜗牛和水母都是无脊椎动物。

Animals: Body Plans · 3/10

Symmetry对称性

Radial symmetry: many cuts through the centre give matching halves. Bilateral symmetry: only one cut gives mirror halves. Asymmetric: none.辐射对称：过中心的多种切法都得到相同两半；两侧对称：只有一种切法得到镜像两半；不对称：没有。

Animals: Body Plans · 4/10

Directions on the body身体的方位词

Anterior is the head end and posterior the tail end. Dorsal is the back and ventral is the belly. Only bilateral animals have clear front and back.前端是头端，后端是尾端；背侧是背，腹侧是腹。只有两侧对称的动物有明确的前后。

Animals: Body Plans · 5/10

Cephalization头化

Bilateral animals that move head-first gain from having sense organs and a brain at the front. This is cephalization.向前移动的两侧对称动物，把感觉器官和脑集中在前端更有利，这就是头化。

Animals: Body Plans · 6/10

Three germ layers三个胚层

Ectoderm becomes skin and nerves. Mesoderm becomes muscle and bone. Endoderm becomes the gut lining and organs.外胚层形成皮肤和神经；中胚层形成肌肉和骨；内胚层形成消化道内壁和器官。

Animals: Body Plans · 7/10

Body cavities体腔

Acoelomates have none. Pseudocoelomates have a cavity partly lined by mesoderm. Coelomates have a coelom fully lined by mesoderm.无体腔动物没有体腔；假体腔动物的体腔只有部分被中胚层包裹；真体腔动物的体腔完全被中胚层包裹。

Animals: Body Plans · 8/10

From zygote to gastrula从受精卵到原肠胚

A zygote divides into a hollow ball, the blastula. The ball folds in to make a gastrula with germ layers and an opening, the blastopore.受精卵分裂成空心球（囊胚）；球体内陷成为有胚层和开口（原口）的原肠胚。

Animals: Body Plans · 9/10

Protostome or deuterostome?原口还是后口？

If the blastopore becomes the mouth, it is a protostome (worms, snails, insects). If it becomes the anus, it is a deuterostome (sea stars, vertebrates).原口变成嘴的是原口动物（蠕虫、蜗牛、昆虫）；变成肛门的是后口动物（海星、脊椎动物）。

Animals: Body Plans · 10/10

Skeleton types骨骼类型

Exoskeleton: hard covering outside, as in insects. Endoskeleton: inside, as in vertebrates. Hydrostatic skeleton: fluid squeezed by muscles, as in earthworms.外骨骼：外部硬壳（昆虫）；内骨骼：体内骨架（脊椎动物）；流体静力骨骼：肌肉挤压体液（蚯蚓）。

cards.f: AN·i·mal
cards.b:
A multicellular eukaryote with no cell walls that eats other organisms for food.

动物：没有细胞壁、以其他生物为食的多细胞真核生物。

🧠 anima = breath, life.anima = 生命。

Quick check: Do animals have cell walls?

No.

cards.f: in·VER·te·brate
cards.b:
An animal with no backbone. Most animal species are invertebrates.

无脊椎动物：没有脊椎骨的动物，大多数动物种类都是无脊椎动物。

🧠 in- = not, vertebra = joint of the spine.in- = 无。

Quick check: Is a spider a vertebrate?

No. It is an invertebrate.

cards.f: VER·te·brate
cards.b:
An animal with a backbone made of vertebrae.

脊椎动物：有由椎骨构成的脊柱的动物。

🧠 vertebra = bone of the spine.vertebra = 脊椎骨。

Quick check: Name two vertebrates.

For example a fish and a bird.

cards.f: SYM·me·try
cards.b:
Body parts arranged so that a cut can give matching halves.

对称性：身体各部分的排列使得切开后两半相同。

🧠 sym = together, metron = measure.sym = 一起，metron = 度量。

Quick check: What does symmetry mean in animals?

Body parts arranged so a cut gives matching halves.

cards.f: a·SYM·me·try
cards.b:
No symmetry: the body cannot be cut into matching halves. Most sponges are asymmetrical.

不对称：没有对称性：身体无法切成相同的两半，多数海绵属于不对称。

🧠 a- = without.a- = 没有。

Quick check: Which simple animals are asymmetrical?

Most sponges.

cards.f: RA·di·al SYM·me·try
cards.b:
Body parts arranged around a central point, so many cuts through the centre give matching halves.

辐射对称：身体各部分围绕中心排列，通过中心的多种切法都得到相同的两半。

🧠 radius = ray of a wheel.radius = 轮辐。

Quick check: Name an animal with radial symmetry.

A jellyfish or a sea star.

cards.f: bi·LAT·er·al SYM·me·try
cards.b:
A body that can be split into mirror-image left and right halves by one cut.

两侧对称：只有一种切法能把身体分成镜像的左右两半。

🧠 bi = two, latus = side.bi = 二，latus = 侧。

Quick check: Which type of symmetry do humans have?

Bilateral.

cards.f: an·TE·ri·or
cards.b:
The front, or head, end of an animal.

前端：动物的前方，即头端。

🧠 ante = before.ante = 之前。

Quick check: What is the anterior end of an animal?

The head end.

cards.f: pos·TE·ri·or
cards.b:
The back, or tail, end of an animal.

后端：动物的后方，即尾端。

🧠 post = after.post = 之后。

Quick check: What is the posterior end?

The tail end.

cards.f: DOR·sal
cards.b:
Relating to the back, or upper side, of an animal.

背侧的：与动物背部（上侧）有关的。

🧠 dorsal fin = the fin on a shark's back.dorsal fin 就是鲨鱼背上的鳍。

Quick check: Where is a dorsal fin?

On the back.

cards.f: VEN·tral
cards.b:
Relating to the belly, or underside, of an animal.

腹侧的：与动物腹部（下侧）有关的。

🧠 venter = belly.venter = 腹部。

Quick check: Which side is ventral?

The belly side.

cards.f: ceph·a·li·ZA·tion
cards.b:
The gathering of sense organs and nerve cells at the head end.

头化：感觉器官和神经细胞集中在头端。

🧠 cephal = head.cephal = 头。

Quick check: Which type of symmetry goes with cephalization?

Bilateral symmetry.

cards.f: GERM LAY·er
cards.b:
One of the layers of cells in an early embryo that develop into the body's tissues.

胚层：早期胚胎中的细胞层，会发育成身体的各种组织。

🧠 germ = seed or beginning.germ = 萌芽。

Quick check: How many germ layers can an animal embryo have?

Two or three.

cards.f: EC·to·derm
cards.b:
The outer germ layer. It forms the skin and nervous system.

外胚层：最外层的胚层，形成皮肤和神经系统。

🧠 ecto = outside.ecto = 外。

Quick check: What does ectoderm become?

Skin and the nervous system.

cards.f: MES·o·derm
cards.b:
The middle germ layer. It forms muscles, bones and blood vessels.

中胚层：中间的胚层，形成肌肉、骨骼和血管。

🧠 meso = middle.meso = 中间。

Quick check: What does mesoderm become?

Muscle, bone and blood vessels.

cards.f: EN·do·derm
cards.b:
The inner germ layer. It forms the lining of the gut and many organs.

内胚层：最内层的胚层，形成消化道内壁和许多器官。

🧠 endo = inside.endo = 内。

Quick check: What does endoderm become?

The lining of the gut and organs such as the liver and lungs.

cards.f: dip·lo·BLAS·tic
cards.b:
Having two germ layers (ectoderm and endoderm), as in jellyfish.

二胚层的：只有两个胚层（外胚层和内胚层），如水母。

🧠 diplo = two, blast = bud or germ.diplo = 二。

Quick check: How many germ layers does a jellyfish have?

Two.

cards.f: trip·lo·BLAS·tic
cards.b:
Having three germ layers (ectoderm, mesoderm and endoderm).

三胚层的：有三个胚层（外胚层、中胚层、内胚层）。

🧠 triplo = triple.triplo = 三。

Quick check: Are humans diploblastic or triploblastic?

Triploblastic.

cards.f: BOD·y CAV·i·ty
cards.b:
A fluid-filled space between the gut and the body wall.

体腔：消化道与体壁之间充满液体的空间。

🧠 cavity = hollow.cavity = 空腔。

Quick check: What is a body cavity?

A fluid-filled space between the gut and the body wall.

cards.f: a·COE·lo·mate
cards.b:
An animal with no body cavity, such as a flatworm.

无体腔动物：没有体腔的动物，如扁形动物。

🧠 a- = without, coelom = cavity.a- = 没有。

Quick check: Does a flatworm have a body cavity?

No. It is an acoelomate.

cards.f: pseu·do·COE·lo·mate
cards.b:
An animal whose body cavity is only partly lined with mesoderm, such as a roundworm.

假体腔动物：体腔只有一部分被中胚层包裹的动物，如线虫。

🧠 pseudo = false. False cavity.pseudo = 假。

Quick check: Name a pseudocoelomate.

A roundworm (nematode).

cards.f: COE·lo·mate
cards.b:
An animal with a true coelom: a cavity completely lined with mesoderm.

真体腔动物：有真正体腔的动物：体腔四周完全被中胚层包裹。

🧠 coelom = Greek koiloma, a hollow.koiloma = 空腔。

Quick check: Are humans coelomates?

Yes.

cards.f: COE·lom
cards.b:
A true body cavity completely lined with tissue from the mesoderm.

体腔（真体腔）：内壁完全由中胚层组织包裹的真正体腔。

🧠 pronounced SEE-lom.读作 SEE-lom。

Quick check: Which germ layer lines the coelom?

The mesoderm.

cards.f: seg·men·TA·tion
cards.b:
A body built from repeating sections, as in earthworms and insects.

分节：身体由重复的体节构成，如蚯蚓和昆虫。

🧠 segment = a cut piece.segment = 一段。

Quick check: Name a segmented animal.

An earthworm or an insect.

cards.f: PRO·to·stome
cards.b:
An animal whose first opening in the embryo (the blastopore) becomes the mouth.

原口动物：胚胎的第一个开口（原口）发育成嘴的动物。

🧠 proto = first, stoma = mouth. First mouth.proto = 最先，stoma = 口。

Quick check: What does the blastopore become in a protostome?

The mouth.

cards.f: DEU·ter·o·stome
cards.b:
An animal whose blastopore becomes the anus, and the mouth forms later.

后口动物：胚胎的原口发育成肛门、嘴在后来形成的动物。

🧠 deutero = second. Second mouth.deutero = 第二。

Quick check: Are humans protostomes or deuterostomes?

Deuterostomes.

cards.f: BLAS·tu·la
cards.b:
An early embryo: a hollow ball of cells.

囊胚：早期胚胎：由细胞构成的空心球。

🧠 blast = bud or germ.blast = 芽。

Quick check: What shape is a blastula?

A hollow ball of cells.

cards.f: GAS·tru·la
cards.b:
An embryo stage in which the ball folds in to make germ layers and a gut opening.

原肠胚：胚胎的一个阶段：球体向内凹陷形成胚层和原肠开口。

🧠 gastr = stomach.gastr = 胃。

Quick check: What forms in the gastrula stage?

The germ layers.

cards.f: SES·sile
cards.b:
Staying attached in one place and not moving.

固着的：固定在一处、不能移动的。

🧠 sessile = sitting.sessile = 坐着的。

Quick check: Name a sessile animal.

A sponge, or an adult coral.

cards.f: MO·tile
cards.b:
Able to move from place to place.

能运动的：能够从一处移到另一处。

🧠 motion + -ile.motion 的形容词。

Quick check: Are most animals sessile or motile?

Motile.

cards.f: ex·o·SKEL·e·ton
cards.b:
A hard skeleton on the outside of the body, such as the shell of a crab or insect.

外骨骼：位于身体外部的坚硬骨架，如螃蟹和昆虫的外壳。

🧠 exo = outside.exo = 外。

Quick check: Name an animal with an exoskeleton.

An insect, a crab or a spider.

cards.f: en·do·SKEL·e·ton
cards.b:
A skeleton inside the body, such as the bones of a vertebrate.

内骨骼：位于体内的骨架，如脊椎动物的骨骼。

🧠 endo = inside.endo = 内。

Quick check: Do humans have an endoskeleton?

Yes.

cards.f: hy·dro·STAT·ic SKEL·e·ton
cards.b:
A fluid-filled body compartment that muscles squeeze to move, as in an earthworm.

流体静力骨骼：充满液体的体腔，肌肉挤压它来产生运动，如蚯蚓。

🧠 hydro = water, static = standing.hydro = 水。

Quick check: Which animal moves using a hydrostatic skeleton?

An earthworm.

cards.f: O·pen CIR·cu·la·to·ry SYS·tem
cards.b:
A system where blood leaves the vessels and bathes the organs directly.

开管式循环系统：血液流出血管、直接浸润器官的循环系统。

🧠 open = not sealed.open = 不封闭。

Quick check: Do insects have an open or closed circulatory system?

Open.

cards.f: CLOSED CIR·cu·la·to·ry SYS·tem
cards.b:
A system where blood stays inside vessels all the time.

闭管式循环系统：血液始终在血管内流动的循环系统。

🧠 closed = sealed in vessels.closed = 封闭在血管里。

Quick check: Do vertebrates have an open or closed circulatory system?

Closed.
